claim_a.text: The package description and comments call the implementation A2A v1.0.

claim_b.text: Its discovery path, AgentCard shape, methods, task model, and streaming behavior do not match A2A v1.

contradictions.resolution: Remove the v1 claim until task 2 replaces the wire surface and task 3 proves it. Preserve any old behavior only as an explicit legacy adapter.
contradictions.audit_trail: Local labels cannot override the normative upstream specification.

claim_a.text: The release bridge targets A2UI v0.9.1.

claim_b.text: The dedicated official A2UI-for-A2A extension page is explicitly v0.8 and legacy.

contradictions.resolution: Carry v0.9.1 A2UI as structured A2A artifact data under a Prometheus-owned, versioned adapter contract unless a current upstream extension URI is verified during implementation. Do not call that adapter upstream A2UI-A2A conformance.
contradictions.audit_trail: Current A2UI catalog guidance still shows the v0.8 extension URI even with v0.9 catalog IDs, so silently inferring a v0.9 URI would be unsafe.

claim_a.text: Some indexed SDK README text still describes v0.3 or a v1 alpha.

claim_b.text: The registry and signed upstream releases publish stable @a2a-js/sdk 1.0.1.

contradictions.resolution: Pin 1.0.1, verify the packed dependency and exports, and treat older indexed README text as stale.
contradictions.audit_trail: pnpm registry metadata and the v1.0.1 source tag agree.

claim_a.text: The TCK covers multiple bindings and normative levels.

claim_b.text: Any passing subset can be reported as full A2A certification.

contradictions.resolution: Pin the TCK commit and report binding, protocol version, normative level, executed scenarios, skips, and exclusions separately. The planned product claims JSON-RPC v1 behavior only.
contradictions.audit_trail: A subset result cannot establish functionality that was not declared or executed.
